name: route2-cml-tts
description: Fine-tune Route-2 v12 TTS on CML-TTS Portuguese shards stored in R2.
trainCmd: mkdir -p /root/r2_data /workspace/checkpoints "$SHARD_CACHE_DIR" && echo '[route2] PULL ROUTE2 BASE' && rclone copyto "$R2_BASE_CKPT" /root/r2_data/best.pt && rclone copyto "$R2_BASE_VOCAB" /root/r2_data/phon_vocab.json && ( while true; do sleep 180; rclone copy /workspace/checkpoints "$R2_CKPT_DEST" --transfers 4 2>/dev/null && echo "MILESTONE CKPT_R2_SYNC $(date -u +%H:%M:%S)"; done ) & SYNC_PID=$!; python trainer.py --data /root/r2_data --sharded_root "$R2_SHARDED_ROOT" --sharded_manifest "$R2_SHARDED_MANIFEST" --shard_cache_dir "$SHARD_CACHE_DIR" --shard_cache_max_gb "$SHARD_CACHE_MAX_GB" --resume /root/r2_data/best.pt --finetune --out /workspace/checkpoints --steps "$ROUTE2_STEPS" --batch "$ROUTE2_BATCH" --lr "$ROUTE2_LR" --bf16 --workers "$ROUTE2_WORKERS" --eval_every 0 --save_every "$ROUTE2_SAVE_EVERY" --log_every "$ROUTE2_LOG_EVERY"; RC=$?; kill "$SYNC_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; rclone copy /workspace/checkpoints "$R2_CKPT_DEST" --transfers 4 2>/dev/null && echo 'MILESTONE CKPT_R2_FINAL'; exit "$RC"
